title: Natural asphalt oxide-grafted carboxylic acid: a sustainable heterogeneous catalyst for synthesis of pyrano[2,3-c]pyrazoles and 2-amino-3-cyanopyridines in water
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25274-25290
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03786G, Paper
Open Access

Shabnam Rashidi, Mohammad Soleiman-Beigi
In this study, we successfully utilized natural asphalt as a natural carbon substrate for the synthesis of a novel heterogeneous Brønsted acid nanocatalyst, Re-NA–CH2CO2H.
